subject: Harbor Registry add-ons renewal — scope / pricing questions
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan A. <jordan@harborregistry.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-06-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion: container registry add-ons (vuln scanning + geo-replication)

Hi Jordan,

We have our Harbor add-ons renewal coming up in July and I wanted to get a fresh quote for the vulnerability scanning and geo-replication SKUs. Usage has grown ~2.8x in the past 12 months and we’re evaluating whether to:
- Continue both add-ons for prod and staging clusters, or
- Limit replication to prod only and use a lighter scanning cadence for staging.

Can you send an updated pricing schedule for annual and 12-month commit options? Also flag any upcoming SKU changes — your team mentioned a billing SKU migration last quarter. If there’s a discount for committing to an annual term we’d like to see it in the proposal.

I’m looping in Marissa (procurement) and Dev (platform) to scope usage. Goal: decide buy vs. scope-down by 2025-06-12.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Jordan A. <jordan@harborregistry.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-06-02T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: container registry add-ons (vuln scanning + geo-replication)

Sean,

Thanks for the heads up — appreciate the timeline. Attached is an updated proposal (Harbor_Addons_Renewal_Q2_v3.pdf) with two options:

1) Annual commit (12 months) — 12% discount off list for full-prod + staging coverage, includes standard SLA and two free incident credits per year.
2) Annual commit (prod-only replication) — 8% discount; staging remains on-demand; scanning cadence reduced to triage-mode for non-prod.

Notes:
- We are migrating some customers to the new billing SKU (ADDON_V2) starting Aug 1; we can lock old SKU pricing through 2025 if we sign before 2025-07-15.
- DocuSign link for the current proposal: https://docusign.com/EXAMPLE-abc123

If you want, I can route a customized quote to pricing for a deeper discount if you can commit to a 24-month term or higher volume.

Best,
Jordan A.
Enterprise Sales, Harbor Registry
jordan@harborregistry.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-06-02T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: container registry add-ons (vuln scanning + geo-replication)

Sean — thanks for looping us in. Quick thoughts:
- 12% on full-prod+staging is decent but staging spend has historically been low value.
- We should confirm actual staging scan frequency (Dev), and whether replication for dev clusters is being used for serves vs. just backups.
- We have budget pressure for Q3; procurement preference is to avoid a price increase vs last year.

Action items for Dev: please pull a 90-day usage export (images scanned, scan run counts, replicated bytes by cluster) and flag anything obviously wasteful. I want a one-page summary by 2025-06-05 EOD so I can present to finance.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-06-03T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: container registry add-ons (vuln scanning + geo-replication)

Marissa / Sean — attaching a usage extract (usage_report_Q1.csv) and my quick read below:

- Scanning: prod runs ~6k scans/month; staging runs ~420 scans/month. We can drop staging to weekly (from daily) with a small CI gating adjustment — estimated 65% reduction in non-prod scanning tokens.
- Replication: ~1.8 TB/day replicated to staging and dev combined; dev accounts for ~30% of replicated bytes and is low-traffic. We can turn off replication for the four dev clusters and retain for prod + pre-prod, saving ~0.5 TB/day.
- Risk: reduced scanning cadence will slightly increase detection-to-remediation window in non-prod; prod remains unchanged.

If procurement wants to pursue the prod-only replication option, I can prepare a small change request (infra config + CI doc) and target a July 1 cutover.

—Dev

Attachment: usage_report_Q1.csv (stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan A. <jordan@harborregistry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2025-06-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: container registry add-ons (vuln scanning + geo-replication)

Jordan — thanks for the proposal and DocuSign link. Quick follow-up before we move to signatures:

1) Pricing: our preference is option (2) prod-only replication + reduced staging scanning cadence. Given our growth and the fact we can scope dev replication off, we propose a 10% discount for a 12-month committed term (we’d be willing to extend to 18 months if needed).
2) SLA: need a single-page addendum confirming 99.9% availability for replication and a 4-hour response target for P1 incidents.
3) SKU lock: we can commit to signing by 2025-06-20 if you can lock ADDON_V1 pricing through 2025-12-31 (to avoid surprise SKU migration).

Please hold the DocuSign until we confirm final pricing and SLA addendum. I’m attaching the usage extract from Dev so you have the numbers.

If pricing requires escalation, let me know and we’ll consider a 24-month term. Next step: can you confirm whether pricing team can accept 10% + our SLA ask?

Thanks,
Sean

From: Jordan A. <jordan@harborregistry.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-06-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: container registry add-ons (vuln scanning + geo-replication)

Sean — appreciate the clarity and the usage file. I’ve escalated to pricing and support to get a firm answer. Quick summary: they are prepared to accept 10% on the prod-only replication option for a 12-month commit provided we sign by 2025-06-20; they will include a one-page SLA addendum with the 99.9% replication availability and a 4-hour P1 response for an additional small administrative fee (we can waive that fee if you commit to 18 months).

I will send an updated proposal and hold the DocuSign pending your final confirmation. Expect the updated PDF by EOD 2025-06-05.

Regards,
Jordan A.
Enterprise Sales, Harbor Registry

Attachment: Harbor_Addons_Renewal_Q2_v3.pdf (stub)
